Apply external forces and torques to bodies — use for modeling gravity, springs, dampers, actuators, or any applied load in a multibody system
Define coordinate frames and spatial transformations — use for positioning, orienting, and relating reference frames within a multibody assembly
Model gear pairs and mechanical couplings — use for spur gears, bevel gears, worm drives, or other power transmission couplings between shafts
Connect bodies with degrees of freedom — use for revolute, prismatic, spherical, or other articulated connections in a multibody mechanism
